resultat: Ilia Topuria bat Alexander Volkanovski par KO (coup de poing) à 3:32 du 2e round.
resultat_en: Ilia Topuria defeats Alexander Volkanovski by KO (punch) at 3:32 of round 2.
contexte: Invaincu, Ilia Topuria met KO Alexander Volkanovski au 2e round et devient champion des poids plumes.
contexte_en: Unbeaten Ilia Topuria knocked out Alexander Volkanovski in round 2 to become featherweight champion.
